description: Address code review issues: fix divergent Research Questions text, consolidate dual animation loops, add accessibility improvements, add globe event listener cleanup, and add noscript fallback.
steps: 1. Fix Research Questions text in index.html to match the canonical wording from fetch-tmdb-data.js

2. Consolidate dual rAF loops - remove standalone globe loop from main.js, integrate into cinematic engine's loop via a registered update callback, and add document.visibilitychange listener to pause when backgrounded
3. Add accessibility: noscript block, role/aria-label on scroll progress bar, sr-only class and screen-reader text, aria-labels on species cards
4. Add dispose() method to Globe class that removes event listeners and disposes Three.js resources
5. Run npm run build to verify
acceptance_criteria: The 4 RQs in index.html match exactly the wording in fetch-tmdb-data.js
Only one requestAnimationFrame loop runs (in cinematic-engine.js), with globe update integrated
The render loop pauses when the tab is backgrounded (document.visibilitychange)
index.html has a <noscript> block with links to all 10 species pages
Scroll progress bar has role=navigation and aria-label
A .sr-only CSS class exists and is used for screen-reader descriptions
Globe class has a dispose() method that removes event listeners and disposes geometries/materials
verification: Run npm run build and confirm success
